articles.title: Meet the 'Fire Amoeba': A Microscopic Blob That Lives in Near-Boiling Water
articles.summary: A new amoeba found in a California volcanic park survives at 145°F, setting a record for complex life. It goes dormant in a protective shell when it gets even hotter.

articles.title: The Game of the Year Race Is Wide Open — Here's Who's Leading
articles.summary: With the Game Awards set for Dec. 10, Resident Evil Requiem leads the pack. But a strategy RPG and a James Bond game are making surprising plays for the top prize.

articles.title: How 'Choosin' Texas' Became the Longest-Running No. 1 Hit Ever
articles.summary: Ella Langley's country ballad just notched its 23rd week atop the Billboard Hot 100, breaking Mariah Carey's record. Streaming, a weak pop year, and loyal sales all played a part.
